title: Fictional shop policy — teaching exercise only
date_basis: Calendar days from delivery to the supplied request date; day 30 is included. Never use the computer clock.

rules.description: A recorded damaged item requires employee review, regardless of the return window.
An unknown or unrecognised item condition requires employee review.
A missing return reason requires employee review.
A non-damaged item requested more than 30 days after delivery is not eligible under this teaching policy.
A used, non-damaged item within the window is not eligible under this teaching policy.
An unused item requested within 0 to 30 days, with a supplied reason, is eligible.

early_stops: Requested item does not match the order
Missing/invalid date or request date before delivery
actions: Draft responses only. No messages sent, refunds issued, labels created or order records changed.
